payload.prompt: Create a template for customers to submit their pilot projects. The form must ask for: 1. A link to an isolated repository. 2. A clear description of ONE bounded remediation task. 3. The exact command for their deterministic acceptance test (e.g. a pytest command). Warn them that no production deployment will occur and they must explicitly provide a Human Gate approval. Save the output to demo_pilot/PILOT_INTAKE_FORM.md.
